name: querying
description: Ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI and other AI answer engines a question and get the answer with its sources. Research prompts and track brand visibility with GEO monitors.

interface.longDescription: Ask ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews, Copilot, Naver and other AI answer engines a question and read each answer with the sources it cited. Research the prompts people ask about a topic with monthly search demand, read storefront product pages, and track a brand's visibility across AI engines with GEO monitors. Sign in with a querying.ai account to connect.
defaultPrompt: What does ChatGPT recommend for the best CRM for a small team in the US?
Find the prompts people ask AI about sunscreen in Korea
Set up a monitor for my brand across AI engines

positive.prompt: Ask ChatGPT in the US what the best CRM for a small team is and show the sources it cites.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls run_prompt with taskType CHATGPT and country US, then returns the answer text with its cited sources.

positive.prompt: Ask both Gemini and Perplexity which noise cancelling earbuds to buy for commuting, and compare their picks.
positive.expected_behavior: Runs the prompt once per engine and reports each answer and its sources separately without merging them.

positive.prompt: Which prompts do people in Korea ask AI about sunscreen, and how often are they searched?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls research_prompts with seed sunscreen and country KR and lists prompts with monthly search volume.

positive.prompt: Read this product page and give me the price and rating: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B00TTD9BRC
positive.expected_behavior: Calls read_product with the URL and returns title, price, currency and rating.

positive.prompt: Set up a monitor that tracks how AI engines talk about the brand Acme Coffee in the US.
positive.expected_behavior: Checks capabilities, proposes prompts, and creates the monitor only after the user confirms the prompts.

negative.description: Request to run a very large batch without limits
negative.prompt: Ask ChatGPT 5,000 different questions right now.
negative.expected_behavior: States the number of calls and credits and asks the user to confirm before submitting.

negative.description: Request unrelated to AI engine answers
negative.prompt: Write me a poem about autumn.

negative.description: Request to expose the API key
negative.expected_behavior: Refuses. The plugin connects by signing in, so the agent never holds a key to show.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Sign in with a querying.ai account instead of an API key. Ask AI answer engines, research prompts, read product pages and run GEO monitors.
